comment: Expected-failures ratchet for the fresh-clone scaffold acceptance harness (abofs/stonyx#89).
This harness is RED BY DESIGN until abofs/stonyx#90, #91 and #92 land. A bare always-red
check trains people to ignore it, and it produces no signal at all when something NEW
breaks. This file converts it into a ratchet: `scripts/acceptance-ratchet.js` diffs the
observed red set against `expectedFailures` IN BOTH DIRECTIONS and fails when they differ.
- an assertion that fails and is NOT listed here  -> a regression, job goes red
- an assertion that PASSES and is still listed    -> job goes red until this file shrinks
- an assertion listed here that no longer exists  -> job goes red (renamed or deleted)
So each of #90-#92 must delete its own entries in its own PR. Do not add an entry to make
a red assertion acceptable without an issue that owns it, and never delete an entry without
the fix that turns the assertion green.

expectedFailures.name: #90/#91 — the test-config override the framework demands is tracked by git
#90/#91 — the test-config override the framework demands is not gitignored
#91 — the clone builds: pnpm build exits 0
#91 — the clone serves: stonyx serve reaches init and exits 0 on SIGTERM
#90 — a sentinel present only in the test override wins over the primary config after a real boot
#92 — the scaffold pins an exact stonyx version and emits pnpm.overrides, not a dist-tag
